The '''Hasaq system''' was located in the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Nanth'ri Route]], which linked it to the [[Attahox system/Legends|Attahox]], [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous]], and [[Zaloriis system/Legends|Zaloriis systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> and contained an [[Color/Legends|orange]]-colored [[Hasaq's sun|sun]].<ref name="KOTOR2" /> Between [[3959 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was part of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] founded by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hasaq system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-12.<ref name="TEA" />
